title: Circuits and systems neuroscience: methods and causal evidence
stage: Graduate study and research in neuroscience
audience: a graduate preparing for research in neuroscience or cognitive science, or a graduate student in the first years of a PhD or a research role
purpose: Study how modern neuroscience links circuits to behavior and what each method lets you conclude: electrophysiology from single units to high-density probes, optical imaging of activity, optogenetics and chemogenetics, anatomical tracing and connectomics, behavioral paradigms in animals, causal inference from perturbations, the problems of compensation and off-target effects, cross-species comparison and the translation of findings to humans, with worked studies of sensory, motor, memory and decision circuits.
primary_reading: Neuromatch Academy computational neuroscience course materials (free online)

weeks.1: Questions in systems neuroscience and the logic of evidence
weeks.2: Electrophysiology: from single units to dense probes
weeks.8: Sensory and motor circuits: case studies
weeks.9: Memory and navigation circuits: case studies

blocks.deliverable: Estimate what a recording can and cannot resolve.
Evaluate a connectivity claim from supplied tracing data.
Design controls for an optogenetic experiment.
Week 7 midterm; critique a supplied perturbation study.
Compare correlational and causal evidence for one circuit.
Write a short proposal combining measurement and perturbation.
Submit the project; take an unseen 120 minute final in week 14.

project: Experimental design proposal: write a ten-page proposal for a circuit experiment that tests a causal claim about one behavior, with the circuit hypothesis, the recording and perturbation methods and why, controls for compensation and off-target effects, the analysis plan with power, and what each possible result would show.
completion: finish the project, take the week 7 midterm and week 14 cumulative final, then complete a new cumulative assessment after 1 to 2 weeks. Explain one major idea aloud without notes.
